main_body: wooden column with capital, shaft with gold bands, and base
top_band: medium-light brown top plane on rows 9-12 with a lighter front edge at row 12
evidence: The capital shows a 4-row top surface (rows 9-12) with a bright front edge at row 12, overhanging the vertical capital face (rows 13-15) and casting an eave shadow onto the upper shaft (rows 16-17).

style.evidence: The shaft has stepped wood shading and horizontal grain, but the entire silhouette is enclosed in a heavy, uniform near-black outline and the base is a direct copy of the top capital, giving it a stiffer, sticker-like appearance compared to the Beodeul references.
